Changes made by Realmkeeper: converted from GLB to FBX with Blender 5.2.1 and uniformly scaled to a
real-world height, using Tools/Blender/glb2fbx.py. The geometry, rigs and animations are otherwise unchanged.
Credit is not required; Realmkeeper credits Quaternius anyway.
